verdict.rationale: pnpm's own homepage claims first-class monorepo filtering to run tasks on just the projects you touched, which covers filtered script runs and the affected-by-change subset. Community reports confirm that recursive/parallel workspace commands replace Lerna, but the evidence is a single marketing line with no reference documentation of the filter mechanism. Missing for 10: documentation of filter syntax and change-based (git ref) selection, evidence that installs can be filtered to a package subset, hands-on corroboration of filtering specifically.
